title: RESTORE_FOOTPRINT fails with INSUFFICIENT_REFUNDABLE_FEE
pattern: A transaction whose RESTORE_FOOTPRINT operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (insufficient_refundable_fee). Restoring an evicted persistent entry with a resource fee that covers only the non-refundable part: nothing is left for the rent.

hazards.placement: RestoreFootprint of an evicted entry that cannot pay its rent
